entities.label: Garden in Eden
entities.description: The garden planted by Yahweh God in Eden is where the man is placed. The account names the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil among its trees.
entities.editorial_note: Textual garden, distinguished from the wider named region Eden; no modern geography.

entities.label: River flowing out of Eden
entities.description: An unnamed river flows out of Eden to water the garden and divides into the source of four named rivers. Its identity is retained as the narrative describes it, without a modern river reconstruction.
entities.editorial_note: Anonymous textual river; not equated with one of its four named branches or a modern river.

entities.label: Abraham’s unnamed servant (Genesis 24)
entities.description: Abraham sends his unnamed senior household servant to his relatives to find a wife for Isaac. The servant travels to Mesopotamia and returns with Rebekah; the text does not name him Eliezer.
entities.editorial_note: Role-labeled person scoped to this mission; no identity with Eliezer asserted. Literal role mentions are narrowly scoped and exclude “your servant Isaac” in 24:14.

relations.subject: beer-lahai-roi

relations.subject: chedorlaomer
relations.note: Chedorlaomer and the kings with him are the collective campaign participants. This does not attribute each act of violence to him personally.

relations.subject: abram
relations.note: Narrative describes Abram’s return from defeating Chedorlaomer and allied kings; he leads trained men and servants. This is not a claim that he personally killed this individual.

relations.subject: birsha
relations.note: Named rulers in opposing coalitions in the account of the kings. Symmetric opposition stored once; not personal combat, a separate bilateral campaign, or identification of a later unnamed royal title.

relations.subject: deity-god
relations.note: Command spoken to the man concerning the named tree; not a claim of biological poison, later theology or every human’s identical command.

relations.subject: deity-god

uncertainties.issue: The garden, region Eden, unnamed river and four named branches are distinct textual referents; their modern geographic arrangement is unresolved.
uncertainties.handling: Added only textual planting, location and river-branch relations. No map coordinates or identification with a reconstructed historical system.

uncertainties.issue: Abram’s anticipated heir Eliezer and the unnamed later household servant are not identified as the same person by these passages.
uncertainties.handling: Keep distinct IDs; heir expectation is attributed speech rejected by the subsequent reply, while the unnamed servant’s travel is a narrated action.

located_in.description: Textual containment/location; not equivalence or modern coordinates.

planted.description: Narrated planting of the named garden or plant; not independent historical verification.

flows_from.description: River subject flows out of textual place object.

waters.description: River subject supplies water to garden/place object in narrative.

branch_of.description: Named river subject is one of the rivers sourced by the divided river object in the textual account; no modern hydrological reconstruction.

flows_in_front_of.description: River relative to named land using the supplied WEB phrase; not flow through or a modern cardinal bearing.

kingdom_includes.description: Place object explicitly listed in subject’s kingdom; does not assert a modern title.

camped_west_of.description: Person’s narrated tent location west of place object; not residence within the place.

chose_region.description: Narrated selection of the region object; does not establish land ownership.

named_as_prospective_heir.description: Speaker subject identifies object as anticipated heir; attributed speech required and not actual inheritance.

destroyed.description: Destruction narrated of a place/object; no claim beyond the text.

pronounced_blessing_on.description: Speaker subject utters blessing over person object, not a fulfillment/status claim.

gave_tenth_to.description: Narrated transfer of a tenth to recipient; no universal obligation inferred.

paid.description: Payer subject transfers the payment to recipient object; amount/property retained in evidence and note.

sold_to.description: Seller subject transfers property for payment to buyer object in cited transaction; object is buyer, not property.

on_route_to.description: Location subject explicitly or contextually on the way to place object; not a reconstructed modern route.

participated_in_campaign_at.description: Subject participates in the stated military campaign at place object; does not individually attribute every collective action.

military_victory_over.description: Narrated military leader subject returns victorious over opponent object with respective forces; not personal killing.

military_opponent_of.description: Named rulers in explicitly opposing military coalitions; not a personal duel or separate bilateral war.

prohibited_eating_from.description: Speaker subject prohibits eating from named object in attributed command; addressee and scope in evidence/note.

placed_guards_for.description: Subject arranges guards for access to object/place; not necessarily personally guarding.
